stem: A worker proposes changing a labeled concentration and interval based on an online forum. What is the strongest response?
choices: Follow the current label and applicable site/regulatory requirements rather than improvising an off-label schedule
Use the forum schedule if several people agree
Double the interval and concentration together
Choose whichever schedule uses less product
rationale: Product-use decisions should follow the current label and applicable requirements; online advice is not a substitute for authoritative instructions.
